title: Ah-Tah_Thi-Ki Museum

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Museum fieldtrips are a great way to bring the Seminole Story to life! Our diorama-style permanent exhibits immerse students in the Tribe’s past while temporary exhibits focus on both historic and contemporary topics. Nestled in the heart of the Everglades, students can explore a natural cypress dome as they walk along our beautiful boardwalk which leads to a Seminole Village often featuring Seminole artisans. The Museum offers a variety of programs including tours, craft activities, games, and more. Programs can be tailored to meet your group’s need and support Florida State Educational Standards. services.desc: Design your day by choosing from the activities below. Our most popular option includes an orientation film, gallery tour, and boardwalk tour. You may also wish to schedule time for lunch. The museum offers picnic tables if you would like to bring your own food or you may consider eating at one of the dining establishments located near the Museum. Orientation Film (20 minutes) Learn about the Seminole story from Seminole people with our panaromic film We Seminoles. This short movie provides a great introduction to the history of the Seminole Tribe of Florida. The film is scheduled every 30 minutes.
